description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller class named ShippingMethodsController. Its main responsibility is to handle HTTP requests related to managing shipping methods in an e-commerce admin panel. It provides endpoints to view available shipping methods, configure specific shipping modules, save shipping configurations, and delete shipping methods. The class interacts with a ShippingService for business logic and uses model attributes to set data for views.

classes.name: ShippingMethodsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing shipping Methods configuration in an admin interface, enabling viewing, editing, saving, and deleting shipping modules.

methods.name: displayShippingMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display all available shipping methods and their configurations for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: displayShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display configuration details for a specific shipping method identified by its code.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save updates to a shipping module's configuration.

methods.name: saveCustomWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a custom weight-based shipping configuration.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a shipping method configuration identified by its code.
